# Plotting Non-detections in metabarcoding w/ out 3x zeros
  plotting_drop_outs_all %>% 
    left_join(q_mean) %>% 
    filter(., mean_reads >0) %>% 
  filter(., !is.na(`Target Name`)) %>% 
   ggplot(., aes(x=mean_Quantity, y=drop_prop, colour=`Target Name`, fill=`Target Name`))+
      geom_count(alpha =0.5)  +facet_wrap(`Target Name`~., scale="free") +ylab("Metabarcoding Non Detection") +xlab("qPCR DNA Concentration [copies/L]")  +ggtitle("Non-detections in metabarcoding w/ out 3x zeros if qPCR >0")  +theme(legend.position = "none",axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust = 1), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size=14), axis.title = element_text(size=18), strip.text = element_text(size=16), axis.line = element_line(colour = "grey50"))
